author: Thomas à Kempis
title: Of contempt of all temporal honour

verses.text: “My Son, make it no matter of thine, if thou see others honoured and exalted, and thyself despised and humbled.
verses.modernizedText: “My Son, do not be troubled if you see others honored and exalted, and yourself despised and humbled.

verses.text: Lift up thine heart to Me in heaven, and then the contempt of men upon earth will not make thee sad.”
verses.modernizedText: Lift up your heart to Me in heaven, and then the contempt of people on earth will not make you sad.”

verses.text: O Lord, we are in blindness, and are quickly seduced by vanity.
verses.modernizedText: O Lord, we are blind and are quickly led astray by vanity.

verses.text: If I look rightly within myself, never was injury done unto me by any creature, and therefore I have nought whereof to complain before Thee.
verses.modernizedText: If I look honestly within myself, no creature has ever done me an injury, and therefore I have nothing to complain of before You.

verses.text: But because I have many times and grievously sinned against Thee, all creatures do justly take arms against me.
verses.modernizedText: But because I have sinned against You many times and grievously, all creatures justly take up arms against me.

verses.text: Therefore to me confusion and contempt are justly due, but to Thee praise and honour and glory.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore confusion and contempt are justly due to me, but to You, praise and honor and glory.

verses.text: And except I dispose myself for this, namely, to be willing that every creature should despise and desert me, and that I should be esteemed altogether as nothing, I cannot be inwardly filled with peace and strength, nor spiritually enlightened, nor fully united to Thee.
verses.modernizedText: Unless I prepare myself for this—that is, to be willing that every creature should despise and desert me, and that I should be regarded as nothing at all—I cannot be inwardly filled with peace and strength, nor spiritually enlightened, nor fully united to You.
